# AceMail

> AceMail is an open-source (Apache 2.0) cold email outreach app that sends personalized multi-step sequences from your own Gmail, stops follow-ups automatically when someone replies, and connects to ChatGPT and Claude through an MCP server.

## Key facts
- Mailboxes connect with one-click Google sign-in; no SMTP setup.
- Features: sequences with follow-ups and A/B tests, CSV and Google Sheets import with custom fields, spintax, spam score, email verification, one-click unsubscribe and do-not-contact list, mailbox rotation with per-mailbox limits, unified inbox, open/click/reply/bounce analytics.
- MCP endpoint: https://acemail.online/mcp (OAuth sign-in with an AceMail account).
- Source code: https://github.com/priiyanshuraj/AceMail
- CRM: interactive vertical sales funnel, deal values and close dates, client board, notes, reminders and email/LinkedIn activity. Email reply advancement requires a stage named Replied and skips detected automatic out-of-office replies.
- AI: lead research and saved personalized outreach; bring your own DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible key. Default shared free allowance is 20 cold emails and 20 LinkedIn messages per user/day, adjustable by admin. Own-key and MCP usage remain subject to external provider limits and costs.
- Self-hosting: Docker app deployment with separately configured database/auth, Google integrations and an authenticated queue scheduler. LinkedIn browser execution needs the extension or a separate runner.
